name: morning-brief
prompt: Morning briefing. Do these steps: 1) git_list_repos and flag any repo with uncommitted changes or ahead/behind its remote. 2) gmail_search 'is:unread newer_than:1d' and summarize only what matters (internships, hackathons, interviews, deadlines) - ignore promotions. 3) calendar_list_events for the next 2 days. 4) list_tasks that are pending. Format as short bullets under headers REPOS / MAIL / CALENDAR / TASKS. Under 200 words total.

name: evening-repo-check
prompt: Evening check: run git_list_repos and report ONLY repos with uncommitted changes or that are ahead of their remote, as one line each with the change count. If everything is clean and pushed, say exactly: all repos clean and synced.
